item.title: Delhi High Court restrains counterfeiters from infringing ‘Happi Planet’ trademark; directs Amazon, Flipkart, Meesho to take down fake listings
item.description: The dispute arose from the plaintiff’s allegation that Defendants 1 to 7 were engaged in the large-scale sale of counterfeit and sub-standard home care products bearing the trademark “Happi Planet” and copying the plaintiff’s distinctive packaging and trade dress. The post Delhi High Court restrains counterfeiters from infringing ‘Happi Planet’ trademark; directs Amazon, Flipkart, Meesho to take down fake listings appeared first on SCC Times.

item.title: Rajasthan High Court grants bail to accused in POCSO case where victim allegedly eloped willingly
item.description: In the case at hand, it is evident from the Medical Ossification Report that the victim's age is between 16-18 years. The post Rajasthan High Court grants bail to accused in POCSO case where victim allegedly eloped willingly appeared first on SCC Times.

item.title: Police encounters, firing at accused’s leg become routine to please superior officers: Allahabad High Court seeks explanation from ACS and DGP
item.description: “Although this Court recognizes that police personnel also have the right of private defense and may use force in appropriate circumstances, it is well settled that where death occurs or grievous injuries are caused to the accused, the procedure mandated by the Supreme Court must be strictly followed.” The post Police encounters, firing at accused’s leg become routine to please superior officers: Allahabad High Court seeks explanation from ACS and DGP appeared first on SCC Times.
